name: kaki5-native
description: Aplikasi Android native (Capacitor) untuk Kasir Solo - Kaki Lima

scripts.sync: node sync-www.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:debug: node sync-www.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: node sync-www.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
